title: Landfall and Compass
author: Ansel Ravensworth
blurb: Juniper Winterbourne, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
